items.title: Melba Liston — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: like when Billy Mitchell came in on that saxophone, you had set it up. He came in, and Dizzy.

ctx.x: When you edit it down, boy, it’s together. Whatever you take out, I don’t think it belongs in there. Whatever you leave in, it goes. Because I like the way the accents –

like when Billy Mitchell came in on that saxophone, you had set it up. He came in, and Dizzy. Whew. He came in. And I noticed that the drums accent with the trumpet. Do you do that a lot? Do you write for the drums too?
